title: Oat Milk Passed Soy Milk In Three Years
hook: One plant milk ate the other's lunch.
source: Nielsen U.S. retail scanner data for plant-based milk, reported via AgFunderNews/FoodDive/BevIndustry -- oat milk vs. soy milk dollar sales. 2020 crossover (~$213M oat vs. ~$202M soy) and 2022 figures (oat ~$421M, soy ~$144M) as publicly reported; 2018 figures approximate as publicly reported.
